protocol.input: Unchanged paired FULL arithmetic means, saved as raw float32 arrays
protocol.range_sensitivity: Same maps and win_size=7; only SSIM data_range changes from 1 to each GT map max-min. No clipping or rescaling of predictions.
protocol.range_sensitivity_limit: Exploratory diagnostic, not a replacement for the prespecified scores or a paper-comparable metric
protocol.highpass: image minus Gaussian sigma=1 pixel; Pearson correlation with paired GT
protocol.lowpass: Gaussian sigma=3 pixels; Pearson correlation with paired GT
protocol.frequency_limit: Diagnostic texture agreement, not vessel segmentation, accuracy, or a causal test; Gaussian filters only used to compute diagnostics, never to alter reported predictions
